essence: Proper purification of the ears and eyes is enjoined as a declared requirement.
The head is purified through bowing to Hari.
Purification is prescribed for both the inner self and the nose.
A single purifying agent is declared capable of purifying everything.
The Nandaka is placed in the middle of the heart and the conch and discus on the two arms.
